description: This file defines Express.js routes for managing weekly reports, including creation, retrieval, listing, updating, and deletion. It sets up API endpoints with Swagger annotations for documentation, and delegates the handling logic to an external controller.

methods.name: router.post
methods.description: Sets up the POST endpoint to create a new weekly report.

methods.name: router.get
methods.description: Sets up GET endpoints for retrieving specific reports and listing reports with optional filters.

methods.name: router.patch
methods.description: Sets up the PATCH endpoint for updating existing reports.

methods.name: router.delete
methods.description: Sets up the DELETE endpoint for removing reports.
